English for Adults A2 · Week 5 · Lesson 2 · Listening Mission

The tenancy contract

Situation: A tenant asks an agent about a practice contract. Une locataire pose des questions à une agente sur un contrat d’entraînement.

Your mission: Listen for the payment, deposit and notice details. Écoutez les informations sur le paiement, la caution et le préavis.

About 5 to 8 minutes. You can listen as many times as you like. The contract details are invented for English practice.

Words you may know

  • cheque
  • deposit
  • notice period
  • agent fee

Listen to the whole conversation. Écoutez toute la conversation.

TenantMariam
AgentHana

What are they doing? Que font-elles ?

Listen again. Fix the contract notes. Écoutez encore. Corrigez les notes du contrat.

TenantMariam
AgentHana

Check your notes. Vérifiez vos notes.

Mission finished. Mission terminée.

You listened for the payment, deposit and notice details.

  • Paymentfour cheques
  • Depositcan be refunded, subject to the contract conditions
  • Noticesixty days
  • Agent feearranging the tenancy, not maintenance
